note: Stages apply to every style and target unless they list some. 'optional' stages may be skipped.

workflows.title: Creature or character
workflows.summary: Proportions first, a lofted blockout, then only the detail the style and target need.

stages.goal: Choose head units and place landmarks; get a readable silhouette.
stages.checkpoint: Front and right captures are recognisable from outline alone.

stages.goal: Replace boxes with lofted torso, limbs and head volumes.
stages.checkpoint: Proportions still match; parts overlap where they join.

stages.goal: Refine jaw, brow, muscles and asymmetry without changing topology.
stages.checkpoint: Three-quarter capture shows clear primary and secondary forms.

stages.goal: Optionally fuse parts and add broad surface detail on a copy.
stages.checkpoint: One component, no non-manifold edges.

stages.goal: Build a deformable cage over the dense surface.
stages.checkpoint: Cage within budget with loops at joints.

stages.goal: Add UVs if the look or the engine needs textures.
stages.checkpoint: A checker texture looks even.

stages.goal: Assign a few materials with believable roughness.
stages.checkpoint: Material capture separates skin, cloth and metal.

stages.goal: Add a skeleton only if it must be posed or animated.
stages.checkpoint: A bent joint keeps its volume.

stages.goal: Apply transforms, meet the budget, export and verify.
stages.checkpoint: Triangles within budget and the export opens correctly.

workflows.title: Weapon or hand-held prop
workflows.summary: Blockout from reference proportions, hard-surface shaping, then materials.

stages.goal: Block out blade, guard, grip and pommel as separate parts at true scale.
stages.checkpoint: Front capture reads clearly; part lengths are plausible.

stages.goal: Taper and profile each part; use curves for wrapped grips or curved guards.
stages.checkpoint: Silhouette is distinct and edges are intentional.

stages.goal: Add small bevels so edges catch light.
stages.checkpoint: No non-manifold or zero-area faces in the evaluated mesh.

stages.goal: Add UVs before using image textures.
stages.checkpoint: A checker texture looks even.

stages.goal: Separate metal, wood and leather by metallic and roughness.
stages.checkpoint: Materials are distinguishable in a material capture.

stages.goal: Set the pivot at the grip, apply scale, budget and export.
stages.checkpoint: Within budget and correctly oriented after export.

workflows.title: House, building or environment
workflows.summary: Fix a grid, build a small kit, assemble it, then vary and optimise.

stages.goal: Choose the grid unit and block out footprint, storeys and roof volume.
stages.checkpoint: Top and front captures show the intended footprint and height.

stages.goal: Build wall, door, window, floor and roof modules with corner pivots.
stages.checkpoint: Each module is clean and snaps to the grid.

stages.goal: Assemble with linked duplicates and check alignment.
stages.checkpoint: No gaps or visible overlaps from top and front.

stages.goal: Add trim, props and repeated detail procedurally.
stages.checkpoint: Repetition is not obvious.

stages.goal: Use a few shared materials with UVs at a consistent scale.
stages.checkpoint: Texel density matches across modules.

stages.goal: Share meshes, count triangles, export and verify.
stages.checkpoint: Within budget and instances survive export.

workflows.title: Mechanical or manufactured object
workflows.summary: Primitive blockout, boolean and bevel shaping, then materials.

stages.goal: Block out main volumes at real scale.
stages.checkpoint: Proportions read from front, right and top.

stages.goal: Cut and join forms non-destructively.
stages.checkpoint: Evaluated mesh has no non-manifold edges.

stages.goal: Bevel and check shading.
stages.checkpoint: Edges catch light with no pinching.

stages.goal: Add UVs if needed and assign materials.
stages.checkpoint: Materials are distinct in a material capture.

stages.goal: Apply transforms, budget, export and verify.
stages.checkpoint: Within budget and the export opens correctly.

workflows.title: General modeling
workflows.summary: Choose a technique, block out, refine, then surface.

stages.goal: Pick a technique from the guide index: boxes for planar forms, lofts for limbs, curves for sweeps, modules for repetition.
stages.checkpoint: One technique chosen with a reason.

stages.goal: Block out proportions and silhouette.
stages.checkpoint: Silhouette reads from front and right.

stages.goal: Add detail only where it changes the result.
stages.checkpoint: No mesh errors.

stages.goal: Assign materials.
stages.checkpoint: Material capture looks as intended.

stages.goal: Optimise and export.
stages.checkpoint: The export opens correctly.
